form.title: RDDC FHIR to OMOP
form.description: FHIR R4 resources in a deposited batch to OMOP CDM 5.4 tables (Parquet or CSV), with a QC report. Source codes are mapped to OMOP concepts with an Athena vocabulary.

vocab_dir.title: OMOP vocabulary
vocab_dir.description: The folder of an RDDC OMOP vocabulary dataset that holds CONCEPT.csv, CONCEPT_RELATIONSHIP.csv and VOCABULARY.csv (the unzipped Athena download).

output_format.title: Output format
output_format.description: File format of the OMOP tables.

source_name.title: Source name
source_name.description: cdm_source.cdm_source_name (optional; default: the name in the batch's sidecar).

strict_qc.title: Fail on QC failures
strict_qc.description: Fail the run if any QC check has status 'fail'.

max_object_mb.title: Largest JSON object (MB)
max_object_mb.description: Size limit for a single JSON object, e.g. one patient Bundle. Raise it for very large Bundles.
